file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The issue describes the Export button remaining disabled after a failed export attempt. This behavior is controlled in the ExportButton component, specifically managing the busy state that controls the disabled property of the button. The bug is likely due to the busy state not being reset (i.e., set back to false) after an error occurs during export. Fixing the logic in src/components/ExportButton.tsx to ensure busy is cleared on export failure should resolve this.

The issue is that the Export button's busy state does not get reset on failed export attempts, causing the button to remain disabled. The ExportButton component (src/components/ExportButton.tsx) manages the busy state and needs to be fixed to clear it properly after a failure so the button can be clicked again without a page reload.
